exact_recursion: R(k)=union_a {q in R(k+e_a):U_a(q)>=max_b min_(z in R(k+e_b))U_b(z)}
caches: all attainable outcome sets by counts, not a shared Markov selector
arithmetic: 60 is divisible by denominators1..5; welfare integral; util[t][a]=60 times payoff for occupied a

evaluate_contract.nonnegative_complete_input_sufficient_do: 60N<=2147483647, so N<=35791394 and N^2 fits long long
evaluate_contract.outputs: OPT minimum root outcome count and every attainable terminal count vector; no full policy

restarts: every3000 or stay>1000; two stages disjoint5+four1 (second adds five0..2 noises), every third 12 random increments1..15
proposal: usually1 coordinate, probability1/10 branch2..9; delta +/-1 or +/-1..10; clip0..200
acceptance: strict ratio improvement or equal ratio with probability1/4
save: strict best improvement, all nonzero integer types, one worst terminal; no full action tree; ofstream not checked
zero_ratio_boundary: 0/0 treated equal in cross-product walk; never a positive best improvement
stop: round budget only, no ratio>2 exit and no exhaustive finite-box sweep
